user.title: Set up Family Dashboard
user.description: Pick what your Roku Home dashboard should show. The meal-plan helper is created for you; you can change everything later in the integration's options.

data.panel_enabled: Show Family Dashboard in the Home Assistant menu

data_description.indoor_entity: Sensor or climate entity used for the inside temperature card.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Weather entity used for the outside conditions card. Auto-detected if left empty.
data_description.secondary_weather_entity: Optional second weather entity shown on the Weather tab when using five or fewer forecast periods.
data_description.weather_tab_enabled: Adds a dedicated Weather tab to the Roku dashboard.
data_description.forecast_type: Show a daily or hourly forecast.
data_description.forecast_count: How many forecast cards the Roku should display.
data_description.calendar_entities: Only events from the selected calendars are shown on the Home tab. Leave empty to show all calendars.
data_description.meal_entity: Text helper shown in the meal-plan panel. 'Create new helper' makes input_text.roku_dashboard_meal_plan for you.
data_description.background_url: Any image URL Home Assistant can reach, e.g. /local/fall.jpg
data_description.lights_tab_enabled: Adds the Lights control tab to Roku.
data_description.light_entities: Only selected lights can be controlled from Roku.
data_description.scenes_tab_enabled: Adds the Scenes control tab to Roku.
data_description.scene_entities: Only selected scenes and scripts can be activated from Roku.

data_description.climate_entities: Only selected thermostats can be controlled from Roku.
data_description.security_tab_enabled: Adds the Security tab to Roku.
data_description.security_cover_entities: Select up to two garage door covers.
data_description.security_lock_entities: Select up to four door locks.
data_description.security_family_entities: Select person entities to show home/not-home status.

theme.title: Theme and colors
theme.description: Choose the dashboard palette. Changes apply to the web app, Home Assistant panel, and supported Roku surfaces.

data_description.theme_header_text: Dashboard title and page title text. Hex colour, for example #FFF7EA.
data_description.theme_item_header_text: Headings inside cards and panels. Hex colour, for example #EFB26C.
data_description.theme_body_text: Primary event, value, and control text. Hex colour, for example #FFF7EA.
data_description.theme_muted_text: Dates, hints, details, and secondary values. Hex colour, for example #CDBDA9.
data_description.theme_accent: Highlights, calendar markers, and active accents. Hex colour, for example #E18A45.
data_description.theme_background: Used behind the dashboard when no image fills the screen. Hex colour, for example #17100B.
data_description.theme_item_background: Base color for cards, controls, event items, and dialogs. Hex colour, for example #1F1711.
data_description.theme_selected_background: Fill color for active tabs and selected controls. Hex colour, for example #9B542B.
data_description.theme_selected_border: Focus ring and active selection outline. Hex colour, for example #FFD28C.
data_description.theme_item_border: Normal border around cards and controls. Hex colour, for example #59483C.
data_description.theme_item_opacity: Transparency of cards over the dashboard background.
data_description.theme_background_overlay: How much the background image is darkened for readability.

error.invalid_color: This is not a hex colour. Use six hex digits, for example #1F1711.
